title: 日本ダービーの後に・疲弊の理由

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff… Pant, pant… I managed… to make it to the end… But…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Uuugh… Why… are my legs… so heavy? This feels like…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooosh!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (It feels like I just walked through a fierce blizzard. Even my toes feel exhausted…)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (So this… is the Japanese Derby…)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Wheeze… huff… huff… Uuugh…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You okay?! Need a cheer or three?! Here's some water!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I rush out to meet Kitasan Black, who looks absolutely crushed with fatigue. Voices behind me prick my attention.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: What's up with Kitasan Black? Looks like she ran into a wall or something…

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: It's probably the distance she ran. Plenty of Umamusume end up like that after running the Derby…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It takes Kitasan Black quite a while to recover enough to talk normally.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yes, I think so… But wow. I was so sure I'd be tough enough to handle the race.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Is the Derby just that intense? Or am I this tired because of something else?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After some deliberation, I decide to tell her about the conversation I overheard and am worrying about.
choice_data_list: Someone said the race's distance might be the problem.
Someone said the race's distance might be the problem.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Distance… Are you saying 2,400 meters is too much for me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can't say for sure if that's true. Today is the first time she's run in a G1 race this long.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As her trainer, I was sure she could handle long distances, but after watching her run today, I can't say for certain anymore.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hmm, what to do? Maybe shorter races are more my thing…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Up until now, I've always just run all out without paying much attention to distances and stuff.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: No worries, Kitasan Black! There's nothing to fret about!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O, who has been listening to us talk the whole time, inserts herself into the conversation, full of confidence.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Today was just a fluke. You're absolutely fine, so rest assured!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: How can you be so sure I'll be okay, Bakushin O?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Heh heh heh! How could I not be? Just who do you think your super special coach is, hm?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It is I, Sakura Bakushin O! The Umamusume who has been victorious in three 1,200-meter races—aka 3,600 meters total! That's super long distance!
choice_data_list: So long distances… are just a couple of short distances stacked together?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As far as I know, Sakura Bakushin O is a specialized sprinter who has had many great showings in G1 sprints.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That said, I've never heard anyone lump three 1,200-meter sprints into one long-distance 3,600-meter race… That's just not sound reasoning.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: If Bakushin O says I'll be okay, then I just might be okay! Right, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Uhh, I'm not really sure it's quite that simple…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I gently try to stop Kitasan Black from taking Sakura Bakushin O's word at face value.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Distance aptitude aside, there's not much we can do aside from watch how things unfold on the track from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Well, if I'm not really cut out for long races…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: The autumn Kikuka Sho might be even tougher. That's 3,000 meters long. I'd better keep my nose to the grindstone and train real hard!
